Miguel / team — quick summary from the agreed runs (attached CSV). TL;DR: we hit the MAP acceptance targets for the pilot environment with the caveats below.

Summary metrics (server-side generation only):
- TTFT median: 360ms (goal <= 400ms)
- p50 latency (generation): 220ms
- p95 latency (generation): 1.05s (goal <= 1.2s)
- Sustained tokens/sec across pool (80 concurrent sessions): 58.3k tokens/sec (goal >= 55k)
- Error rate (5xx + timeouts): 1.1% (goal < 2%)
- Cold-start window: first 3 warm-up requests show TTFT spike to ~1.4s; KV cache warm after ~6 sessions.

Observations / caveats:
- The p95 numbers spike when prompt lengths exceed 700 tokens; MAP acceptance was defined at <=512 tokens — recommend we enforce prompt-length caps for production traffic or profile longer flows separately.
- End-to-end (EdgeWave ingestion path + network) added ~120–280ms variability on top of server-side numbers; if you want end-to-end acceptance we can re-run with your ingestion agents.

Attachments: benchmark-results-20260819.csv (raw samples + aggregated), load-schedule.ics (calendar invites we used).

Next steps:
1) Update MAP acceptance criteria to reference the exact prompt-length envelope (<=512 tokens) — Vanessa to update spreadsheet.
2) Procurement sign-off: Hannah to provide a short one-page performance certifying note for procurement that summarizes the run and the acceptance pass.
3) Follow-up: 1-week extended soak on dedicated cluster (post-contract) to validate long tail and burst behavior.

If this looks good I will share the one-pager and ask procurement to proceed with the standard SOW and reserved capacity options.

Thanks — great collaboration.
